evidencePolicy: These are reusable generated side-room concepts, not additional canon-named locations. Context/status records the supported host motif; every side-room instance, layout, furnishing arrangement, and cache is an inferred game adaptation.

archetypes.label: Unmarked supply recess
archetypes.description: Small unmarked niche with a supply cache, dressed with crates or barrels; generic environment dressing, not a named canonical room.
archetypes.canonNote: Storage clutter is generic adaptation; no specific room is asserted.

archetypes.label: Narrow service passage
archetypes.description: Short side passage with pipe, drain, torch or crate dressing. It holds an optional supply cache, reconnects to its host district, and never adds a route gate.
archetypes.canonNote: Branching passages are supported broadly; this service corridor is invented. Cache contents are invented game rewards.

archetypes.label: Rubbish pocket
archetypes.description: Small rubbish-filled pocket with a cache using Hoarder/Scatterer lair visual vocabulary; not a separate nest.
archetypes.canonNote: Rubbish piles occur in the Hoarder’s lair; this generated pocket is not a separate canon location.

archetypes.label: Unoccupied creature den
archetypes.description: Tucked-away generic nook with sparse crate/barrel/torch dressing. It holds an optional supply cache; no creature, resident or enemy encounter is implied.
archetypes.canonNote: Creature territories are referenced in Book 1; this empty generic nook is not a named den and spawns no creature. Cache contents are invented game rewards.

archetypes.label: Workshop storage annex
archetypes.description: A small workbench-and-crate nook next to the goblin workshop, used as generated set dressing and optional cache space.
archetypes.canonNote: The workshop itself is canonical; the annex and cache are game inventions. It adds no goblin encounter.

archetypes.label: Resting nook
archetypes.description: Bench-and-cot alcove beside an established safe-room district. It holds an optional supply cache; it is not protected and has no camp/resume behavior.
archetypes.canonNote: Host is an established safe room/camp; generated nook is not itself safe or canon.

archetypes.label: Gym equipment alcove
archetypes.description: A generic storage alcove with gym equipment and an optional cache near the Juicer’s gym.
archetypes.canonNote: Gym equipment is supported at the Juicer’s gym; a separate equipment store and cache are invented.

archetypes.label: Torch maintenance niche
archetypes.description: Wall-side niche with torch and crate dressing for variation along established rock passages, holding an optional cache.
archetypes.canonNote: Torchlit passages are supported generally; this maintenance niche is invented. Cache contents are invented game rewards.
